variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body: The project {project} is badly behind schedule. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Construction timetable falls seriously short
variants.body: Construction on {project} is severely delayed. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: A project waits beyond its schedule
variants.body: The project {project} has fallen badly behind its schedule. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
